title: tokarev's 1st chechen war pack
description: 4000+ downloads on curseforge,also know as comrade pack It adds Soviet gun like AKS-74 (a.k.a AK-74) or Makarov PM, soviet tools, vodka, rubles, canister and more
body:
1st chechen war was a conflict between federal forces and chechen forces. russians entered chechnya on 11 december, 1994. they captured znamenskoje (znamenskoje gave up without fight), goity before they surroundered grozny from west, north and south. first federal troops arrived to grozny around 17-18 december and the first shootings in grozny started on 22 december. the main assault began on 31 december where chechens attacked BMP-2's, BTR-80's and T72's from rocket launchers from rooftops, russians had to bomb whole city. when bombing a lot of war crimes were commited killing thousand of civilians.they suffered big losses but around february, 1995 they succeeded to capture the city, but lost thousands of troops, soon after they began attacking argun , gudermes and samashki. they also tried to take over a village called ''bamut'' but the village successfully defended for over 1 and half a year. in 1996 the operation "Jihad" started. thousands of chechen fighters gathered up and started taking over argun, gudermes and grozny which forced russia to retreat troops from the country and give chechnya de facto independence. the state of republic was said to be postponed for 5 years



[NO OPTIFNE REQUIRED] a lot of resource packs with guns are mainly base off world war 1, world war 2 , wild west, video games so i make one based around first chechen war (1994-1996). the items it adds are: AKS-74, makarov PM, ice axe, fire axe, ZiK axe, crowbar, hammer, sickle, manure fork, kitchen knife, 6h4 AKM type ll bayonet,6h5 bayonet, golden 6h4 bayonet, MPL-50 shovel, tonfa (a.k.a police baton), gas pipe, canisters, chicken tushonka, beef tushonka, empty can, AI-2 medical kit, bread ''brick'', 7.62x39mm & 9x18mm ammuntion box, soviet rubles, lighter, Cigarettes prop, custom armor and more.in chechnya partisans used anything  that work so that is why i have a lot of tools. it have custom polish, english and russian lang
